title: MothOut Moth Killer Spray – Wardrobe & Carpet Moth Treatment for Home & Commercial Use, Long-Lasting Insecticide for Fabric Pests, Carpet Beetles, Larvae & Pupae. Low Odour & Residual Action (1 Litre)
bullet_points: POWERFUL MOTH KILLER FOR ALL LIFE STAGES MothOut Moth Killer Spray kills moths instantly and disrupts their life cycle. It targets pupae, larvae, and adult moths including Common Webbing Clothes Moths, Case-Bearing Carpet Moths, Pale-Backed Moths, Brown House Moths, and White-Shouldered Moths. Formulated to eliminate infestations and prevent recurrence, it ensures maximum protection for carpets, wardrobes, rugs, fabrics, and storage areas

EXTRA-LARGE 1L BOTTLE FOR MAXIMUM COVERAGE Now available in a 1-litre size, this high-capacity moth killer spray is ideal for full-room or multi-room treatments. One bottle covers up to 1000m³ of space or 50m² of surface, making it a cost-effective solution for larger homes, lofts, commercial spaces, and frequent use. No dilution needed - ready to spray straight from the bottle.

FAST ACTING WITH LONG-LASTING RESULTS MothOut’s advanced formula delivers immediate knockdown of visible moths and keeps working after drying. The residual barrier offers up to 12 weeks of ongoing protection, helping break the moth breeding cycle. Perfect for homes, wardrobes, under furniture, and along carpet edges where larvae often hide.

SAFE FOR HOMES, GENTLE ON FABRICS This low-odour, water-based solution is gentle on wool, silk, cotton, and delicate textiles. It won’t stain carpets, upholstery, curtains, or soft furnishings. Unlike mothballs or chemical-heavy treatments, MothOut leaves no strong smell or sticky residue, making it ideal for use in living spaces, bedrooms, and storage.

TRUSTED FORMULA – HSE REGISTERED & UK MADE Manufactured in the UK under strict quality control and fully approved by the Health & Safety Executive (HSE No. 10803-GB). Designed for both domestic and professional use, MothOut delivers industry-standard results with safety you can trust for your family and home environment.

KILLS CARPET BEETLES, LARVAE & PUPAE More than just a moth spray, MothOut also eliminates carpet beetles and other textile-damaging pests. It destroys pupae, larvae, and adults - preventing re-infestation at every stage. Use as part of a total pest protection routine to defend high-risk areas like wardrobes, lofts, skirting boards, or behind furniture.

FOR HOME, COMMERCIAL & PUBLIC USE MothOut is suitable for a wide range of environments including residential homes, museums, offices, hotels, hospitals, and public transport. Apply on hard surfaces, cracks, crevices or fabrics with ease. Its fine mist and flexible trigger make precise treatment fast and effective wherever moths or larvae are found.

READY TO USE – NO MIXING REQUIRED This pre-mixed formula comes ready to spray - simply shake the bottle well before each use. Apply 1ml per cubic metre as a space treatment, or 20ml per square metre for direct surface control. The larger 1L format offers professional-level protection in a convenient trigger bottle - perfect for seasonal re-treatment and full-home coverage.

INCLUDES FREE EBOOK WITH EXPERT TIPS Each purchase includes a downloadable digital eBook with expert instructions on treating, identifying, and preventing moth infestations. Learn how to monitor risk zones, store fabrics safely, and maintain a pest-free home. This professional guide helps you get the most out of every treatment.
description: MothOut is the versatile, professional-grade solution for fabric pests and more. Proudly manufactured in the UK and HSE-registered (No. 10803-GB), it meets strict safety regulations while providing military-strength control. Beyond moths, it can help defend against other household invaders. Use it along baseboards, in cracks, or on skirting boards to keep clothes moths, carpet beetles, clothes beetles, and similar textile pests at bay. It also knocks out common crawling insects like ants, fleas and cockroaches if they come into contact with the spray, making it a broad-spectrum pest deterrent. Large Coverage: A 1 L bottle covers roughly 20–40 m² of surface area (depending on application rate), enough for multiple rooms. This means one 1L bottle can protect an entire family home or office space. Flexible Application: Use MothOut as either a space spray or surface spray. For air treatment, spray 1–4 ml/m³ of room volume (walk the room slowly while spraying) to blanket flying moths. For targeted treatment, apply 25–50 ml per m² onto carpets, rug edges, inside wardrobes, drawers and under furniture. No matter which method, the fine mist leaves a thin barrier that future moths cannot cross. Stops New Infestations: By treating hidden harbourage areas (wardrobes, attic insulation, under carpets) MothOut prevents reinvasion. Its active mix interrupts breeding so that even if a stray egg hatches, the young insect will perish on contact. Pair it with pheromone traps to monitor and confirm the infestation is gone. Kills Where Moths Hide: Ideal for dark, secluded spots – spray into cracks, crevices and the undersides of floorboards where moth larvae pupate. It can also be used on fabrics and stuffed furniture directly (always test an inconspicuous patch first). Professional & Trusted: Used by UK pest controllers, this spray brings the same lab-tested technology to consumers. You’ll even receive an expert digital guide on moth identification and prevention with your purchase, so you know exactly how to apply it correctly. In practice: identify infestations (look for holes, webbing or cast skins on garments and carpets) and treat all affected areas. For a typical bedroom (say 4 m×3 m×2.5 m = 30 m³), about 30 sprays (30 ml) dispersed as a space spray will cover the air. After spraying, keep the room closed for 1–2 hours then air it out; avoid re-entering until mist has settled. Afterwards, vacuum the next day to remove dead insects. Reapply every few weeks if moths reappear or seasonally as a preventive measure. MothOut provides peace of mind: you’re using a proven, UK-made insecticide that’s been optimized for home fabric protection. It’s the modern replacement for mothballs – far more effective and without the toxic fumes. Let MothOut be your solution against moth damage and pest incursions, so you can enjoy your clothes and carpets without worry. Authoritative pest control and entomology resources confirm that pyrethroid insecticides like cypermethrin knock down clothes moths and leave a lasting residual barrier, and that pyriproxyfen effectively disrupts growth of carpet beetle and moth larvae. MothOut is registered formula and tested claims are backed by UK Health & Safety Executive approvals. These descriptions draw on manufacturer data and pest management expertise to ensure accurate, complete guidance.
